basics.name: Lucien Marcel Cote
basics.headline: Technical Artist, Systems Thinker, and Game Developer
basics.summary: Game-development and systems professional with experience spanning AAA character art, real-time simulation, workflow automation, municipal technology, software development, team leadership, and technical mentorship.

experience.summary: Supported government and military VR training simulations.
highlights: Managed software research and development while maintaining fidelity in virtual training environments.
Led project planning and stakeholder coordination.
Implemented art pipelines supporting high frame rates and program fidelity.

experience.position: 3D Generalist, Systems Analyst, and Project Manager
experience.summary: Creates real-time assets, production tools, and technical workflows.
highlights: Developed assets for Unity, Unreal, and custom engines.
Created MEL and Python automation tools for artist workflows.
Trained artists in Maya and custom tool usage.

experience.summary: Develops high-fidelity game assets and supports multidisciplinary production.
highlights: Created assets and textures with Maya, ZBrush, and Substance Painter.
Provided technical feedback and mentorship in character-art production.

experience.summary: Built internal software supporting Amazon Marketplace analytics.
highlights: Developed dashboards and visual tools with Salesforce, Azure, and React.
Built internal platforms and workflow tools.

experience.summary: Supported municipal systems and technology modernization.
highlights: Led system upgrades and municipal IT modernization work.
Implemented GIS-based 3D city modeling.
Designed web interfaces and dashboards supporting civic communication and transparency.

experience.summary: Led character-art production for AAA game development.
highlights: Served as principal artist for Cole Phelps and the principal cast of L.A. Noire.
Coordinated character asset creation, pipeline development, and technical troubleshooting.
Worked with the depth-analysis team on deformation and shader workflows for Project WOTO.

experience.summary: Finalized character assets for Happy Feet Two.
highlights: Completed rigging and blend-shape passes for principal and background characters.
Maintained compatibility with the proprietary animation pipeline.
